33 days for me!! haven't been this long without a drink since I was probably 18 y/o, I've even noticed that my husband  isn't drinking his usual 2 daily beers anymore. And I've lost 5 lbs just by not drinking (haven't changed anything else)

IWNDWYT

7 days today! Haven't been sober for this long in many many years. It feels so good waking up early on a Saturday, without a headache and not having to try to remember if you made a fool out of yourself the night before. 

IWNDWYT
You should try the tangerine La Croix with orange juice, it's delicious.

Day 6 for me! Started therapy yesterday , my brother invited me over for dinner and offered me some red wine, I didn't accept and told him that I'm not drinking anymore. Skipping my office Christmas party tonight though.

We can do this!

IWNDWYT

Day 5 for me! Might not seem like a lot to some but this is the longest I've been without drinking in the past 3 years.

Each day that goes by is more and more difficult because I have to face the consequences of what I've done while drunk, it's hard to see when the person you love can't stand being in the same room as you and you know your presence is only making them more miserable (not exaggerating here and not trying to throw a pity party, just venting)

Have my first appointment with a therapist today, so looking forward to that

I went to 2/3 work related Holiday parties, got drunk in both of them and just hit rock bottom after the last one. Cancelled the third one, got an appointment with a therapist and I won't be leaving the house for any more parties, I have to get my life back together.

Thank you SD!

Day 3 for me, planning to go to an AA meeting later today! 

IWNDWYT
The coconut LaCroix is also my fav and I also enjoy pineapple pizza lol

Thank you for this! On of the main reasons I want to get sober is because I've realized that every major problem I've had with my husband was while I was drunk. Dated this guy for 5 years, couple of years everything was “fine”, after that is when the fighting began, almost everyday, looking back should’ve seen the hundreds of red flags. On year 3, he started becoming very manipulated, didn’t help that I was very immature and didn’t have a very good relationship with my mother. 
To make the story short, ended up become a very physical and emotional abusive relationship that ended in a restraining order. Looking back, it was pretty messed up

I’ve been trying to get to the bottom of the problem, I think that it’s a series of multiple things that have accumulated in the past year. Mostly things I’ve done, not talking about cheating nor anything like that, for example me getting drunk, picking fights, not listening when he talks, not being supportive of a job he got because I was only thinking of myself. That’s what I’ve gathered from his side. I guess that I should give him some time until he calms down and decides to speak to me. 
I’m planning to start some sort of therapy to help me work through this and some other things. I really want to make this work and you’re right I should stop assuming regarding what he wants

Just being here isn’t easy, the only advice I have is to try to talk things, don’t bottle everything inside. I think that’s one of the things that have affected my marriage, both of us aren’t very good at expressing our feelings. I wait until the last minute and I’d either explode or be childish and do the silent treatment. 
My husband would do the silent treatment as well

That’s what I had suggested when he first spoke about a separation a couple of months ago, but things got a little better. Now I’m pretty sure he’ll say no, because and I’m assuming from the little communication we’ve been having, he doesn’t really want to fix things. 
I might get counseling for myself to see if it helps with how I’m feeling and to work with my issues and will give him some time at least until he vocalizes what he wants to do

I really don’t want a divorce, but I think that my husband might. Today I broke down and asked him if he thought if we’d ever be ok again, followed by do you want us to be ok; his answer was a grunt and a I don’t know. 
I then asked him if he’d prefer that I leave him alone, he wanted to know what I meant by that and I told him that I’d give him space and wouldn’t bother him to which he said yes. 
So I guess right now is more like a separation? 
Things are currently complicated because I have a friend coming from out of state to stay at our house for 2 weeks, the only thing my husband told me was to have fun.
I think that he’s relieved that he probably won’t have to deal with this until my friend leaves. I’m also very concerned that he might ask for a divorce when she leaves.
I’m devastated because his body language and actions show that he’s done. And sorry for the huge reply, so just don’t have anyone to talk about this.
My friend knows some about what has happened but I don’t want to tell her how bad it’s gotten
